topic: Motionflare: an AI tool that turns a website link into a branded launch video (Product Hunt, 23 Nov)
why_selected: The strongest story whose central claims could be checked on directly opened data, useful to creators and marketers.
why_short: Paste a link, get a launch video.
why_beats_alternatives: Walmart's AI-agent checkout with Meta's Muse (70.5), Nvidia's CEO reinstatement (64.5) and Alexandr Wang's superintelligence essay (57.0) rank higher on discovery but none could be checked on an opened page (and Nvidia's story is tied to politics). Motionflare's launch data and the makers' description were read directly through the Product Hunt connector.
why_this_story: A practical tool for creators and small brands: paste a site link and its makers say it builds a branded launch video. It was one of Product Hunt's top three launches on Monday (208 upvotes observed directly, the only social signal I could measure; X is blocked). It is a FALLBACK: Walmart's AI checkout story is stronger but none of its sources could be opened.
verified_development: On 23 Nov 2026 Motionflare launched on Product Hunt and ranked #3 with 208 upvotes when checked. Its makers describe a tool that turns a website URL into branded motion graphics with music and optional narration, a Film mode for live-action commercials, chat edits and 4K export, with a free option.
disclosure: Disclosure: written by Claude, an Anthropic model. Motionflare is unrelated to Anthropic. Not sponsored.
research_summary: A research pass covered 22 candidates from 23 Nov across AI, commerce, robotics, chips, gaming and creator tools. News, company and social sites are blocked in this environment, so the strongest stories (Walmart's AI-agent checkout with Meta's Muse, Nvidia's CEO reinstatement, Alexandr Wang's essay, a Waymo storm pause) could not be checked on opened pages and were held; a Korean exam story was excluded as political. The Product Hunt connector showed Monday's launches directly: Motionflare ranked #3 with 208 upvotes. Its makers say it turns a website URL into a branded video using the site's own screenshots, logo, colors and copy, with music, optional narration, a Film mode, chat edits and 4K export, and a free option. These are the makers' claims; the tool was not tested.
key_facts: Launched 23 Nov 2026; #3 with 208 upvotes when checked.
Makers' description: URL to branded video with screenshots, logo, colors, copy, music, narration.
Film mode, chat edits, 4K export (makers' claims).
uncertainties: Output quality is untested; every feature is the makers' own description.
Upvotes were still changing on launch day.
Paid pricing and limits of the free option are not stated in the listing.
No independent review or coverage could be opened.
excluded_claims: Any comparison with other video tools.
context: Product Hunt is a daily launch site where tech users upvote new products; a top-three finish is a signal of early interest, not proof of quality.
script:
Paste your website link, and this AI makes the launch video for you.

It's called Motionflare, one of Product Hunt's top three launches on Monday.

Its makers say it pulls your real screenshots, logo, colors and copy from your site.

Then it adds motion graphics, music and optional narration.

You edit it by chatting, and export in up to 4K.

Its listing even shows a free option.

So before you pay an editor, try it on your own site.
